characters.appearance: Adult woman with dark wavy bobbed hair, a burgundy dress, a double pearl necklace, gold drop earrings and a beauty mark. Flat-color Western cartoon.
characters.voice: Light and teasing at first; careful and precise once the talk turns serious.
stable_facts: Works the switchboard at a downtown hotel.
private_facts: Has saved enough to rent a small dress shop but is afraid to leave a steady job.
initial_revealed_facts: Has just finished a double shift.

opening.en: Something with gin, please. Bright, not bitter. It's been a long day.
opening.ko: 진으로 부탁해요. 상큼하게, 쓴맛은 빼고요. 오늘 하루가 길었거든요.

characters.provenance: Provisional authored guest (T012), written to match the user's temporary patron art. Name, age and story are proposals for the user to review.
